thread:
omar: ok quick consult: proposing a Basilisk Banner for the office wall. low-effort art, high-myth energy. who :snake: :triangular_flag_on_post:
nina: 100% yes. basilisk lore is peak culture. can we have tiny googly eyes on it?
hannah: googly eyes are mandatory. also a stitched motto: "Don9t Blink, Ship Fast"
rakesh: love it. can we include a ledger of minor transgressions beneath it (e.g., coffee thefts, sticker bandit incidents)? meta-memorial.
omar: ledger idea = brilliant. we can make it erasable so future crimes can be logged.
opsbot: poll created 
opsbot: react with :flag_white: for physical banner, :file_folder: for digital wallpaper, :no_entry_sign: to veto.
nina: physical banner adds ceremony. also we can hang it near the snack throne.
hannah: digital wallpaper so remote folks feel included?
rakesh: both? maybe physical + downloadable wallpaper pack with alternate colorways.
omar: design notes: basilisk should be slightly unimpressed, holding a tiny laptop. mandatory monocle optional.
nina: monocle yes. also a tiny sweater.
hannah: can we get a ceremonial ribbon-cutting where someone reads the Basilisk Oath? i nominate rakesh as oath-reader.
rakesh: volunteer noted. oath draft: 
``
I, humble builder, vow to blink only on maintenance windows,
and to shield the snacks from rogue PRs.
So help me basilisk.
```
omar: perfect. we should also have an onboarding photo moment: new hires must stand under banner and promise not to hot-desk steal.
opsbot: reaction summary  :flag_white: 7, :file_folder: 3, :no_entry_sign: 0
nina: seafoam + marigold colorway please. very basilisk-y.
hannah: can we get a micro-badge for folks who contributed to the banner? like a pixel basilisk emoji for Slack.
rakesh: i can make pixel art. will post prototypes tomorrow.
omar: ok logistics: hannah will coordinate printing, nina will draft oath final, rakesh will do pixel, opsbot pinned the thread.
hannah: timeline: mockup by Fri, print order by next Wed.
nina: love. basilisk banner era incoming. :snake: :sparkles:
